name: Wrath Of The Tiger
text: Give to the Ava Ayala player. Exhaust Amulets of Power. Amulets of Power cannot be readied. Treat your identity's printed text box as if it were blank. Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Ava Ayala → remove Wrath of the Tiger from the game.

flavor: Another universe's White Tiger is possessed with the idea that Ava has stolen her amulet.
name: Multiversal Feud
text: When Revealed: Place 3 feud counters here. Forced Interrupt: When White Tiger (Angela Del Toro) is defeated, remove a feud counter from here. If the last feud counter was removed, remove each card of the White Tiger nemesis set from the game.

flavor: “Soon, tia Ava. You can't dodge forever.”
name: White Tiger (angela Del Toro)
text: Incite 2. Quickstrike. Forced Interrupt: When this minion would enter play, remove the White Tiger (Angela Del Toro) ally from the game.

name: I'll Be There!
text: When Revealed: White Tiger (Angela Del Toro) activates against you. If White Tiger (Angela Del Toro) is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for White Tiger (Angela Del Toro) and put her into play engaged with you. Shuffle the encounter deck.
